title: SourceCapabilities
description: What the sidecar can deliver for one source or mailbox today. An absent object or an absent member means unknown, as from an older sidecar; clients then keep their previous behavior.

conversations.description: outlook.get_conversation.v1 can read this source's conversations.

attachments.description: Email attachments are known, indexed and exportable for this source.

folders.description: sources.get_folder_hierarchy.v1 returns this source's real folder tree.

recipients.description: To, Cc and Bcc recipients are known for this source's emails, so recipient filters can match them.

openInOutlook.description: Documents carry identifiers that let a local Outlook open them.

documentExport.description: complete when sources.get_document.v1 exports the full stored content; cachedOnly when it can export only what the application cached on this device, so some documents fail with missing_from_local_cache. Extensible; clients treat unknown values as cachedOnly.

metadataFields.description: Names from search.metadata_fields.v1 that this source fills. A filter on any other field cannot match this source's documents.
